title: Melania Trump to Host Ukraine-Russia Meeting at White House, Sky News Reports
detail: Sky News reports that First Lady Melania Trump will host a meeting involving Ukrainian and Russian representatives at the White House. Details on participants, date and agenda were not available in the aggregated summary; single-source report, unconfirmed.

title: Ukraine Launches Fresh Strike on Russian Retail Giant, The Independent Reports
detail: The Independent reports that Kyiv launched a fresh strike on a Russian retail giant. The aggregated summary gave no details on the company, location, weapons used or damage; single-source report, unconfirmed.

title: Kyiv Suffers Worst Water Outage of the War After Mass Russian Missile and Drone Assault
detail: Following a mass Russian missile and drone assault, Kyiv suffered its worst water outage of the full-scale war. Zelensky condemned an 'insane' Russian attack on a school. Single aggregated report; casualty and infrastructure details not available in the summary.
